notes.title: Last Human Standing Holiday Edition!
notes.notes:
Last Human Standing - Holiday Edition Rules


Do you have what it takes to survive the Zombie Apocalypse? We think you might.

Welcome to Undead Lab's Last Human Standing Holiday Edition game! You're here because you are hardcore and built to last. You're ready to face the zombie threat head on. You also want the chance to win fabulous prizes!

Give us your name and your email address. We'll do the rest.

Watch the action happen here on the daily rolls sheet- https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WAxdEb0quPRm_Y7vh4l43sji2M1eSmZCOoUpnuEJJBQ/edit?usp=sharing
and then comment here in the Game Thread - https://forums.undeadlabs.com/threads/last-human-standing-holiday-edition-game-thread.51252/

We'll give out a weekly prize as a consolation for joining the Undead masses. The lucky person to stay alive for the entire game wins a choice of anything we have in our prize closet!

Sign up here - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LPWIY8JAZxPABjMcm_LorhrVZSJss5n_zf-xaDnhPTE/viewform?usp=send_form

Entry to the Contest will close Wednesday Evening (11/25/15) at 11:59 p.m PST before we break for the US Thanksgiving Holiday.

First roll will happen before or at 12:00 p.m. PST Monday, November 30, 2015.

notes.title: YOSE: Steam Update 4/29/15
notes.notes:
Hi folks! 

We have a small update for you this afternoon with some really good fixes. 

This is what we did:
- Fixed an issue on imported save games that was causing the incorrect rucksacks to be looted from specific supply loot locations (finding boxes of ammo from gas cans)
- Fixed an issue on imported save games that caused Cleo drops to spawn as invisible
- Fixed a bug with several achievements that were not being awarded to the player when the criteria was fulfilled

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - State of Decay: YOSE Day One Edition
notes.notes:
State of Decay: YOSE Day One Edition is Now Available on Steam!

Delivered in beautifully remastered 1080p, along with improved lighting, textures, animations, and combat mechanics, State of Decay: Year-One pulls you even deeper into the post-outbreak world.

Purchase the Day One Edition and get the exclusive “Prepper’s Pack”. Day One Edition is only available until May 12, 2015.

Additionally, State of Decay Steam owners instantly receive a 33% discount on the Day One Edition.

State of Decay, along with major Add-Ons Breakdown and Lifeline, is now fully remastered in stunning 1080p. New missions, weapons, and extra content, along with improved lighting, textures, animations and combat mechanics, will pull you even deeper into the post-outbreak world. How will you survive the zombie apocalypse?

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - State of Decay: Year-One
notes.notes:
State of Decay: Year-One is Now Available for Pre-Purchase on Steam and is 33% off for owners of State of Decay!*

Delivered in beautifully remastered 1080p, along with improved lighting, textures, animations, and combat mechanics, State of Decay: Year-One pulls you even deeper into the post-outbreak world. Make your stand against the collapse of society in the ultimate zombie survival-fantasy game. Explore an open world full of dangers and opportunities that respond to your every decision. Recruit a community of playable survivors, each with their own unique skills and talents. Design and fortify your base against the relentless hordes of the undead. Perform daring raids for food and ammunition, and do whatever it takes to live another day.

The Day One Edition available for prepurchase also includes Breakdown Year One, Lifeline Year One, and YOSE Prepper's Pack DLCs.

*Offer ends April 28th at 8AM Pacific Time
